info.description:
Complete scope: every API endpoint in the CRM backend, generated directly from the live backend route/validator source, originally on 2026-10-23 and last refreshed on 2026-11-25 against the current backend routes. Every endpoint below is real and currently deployed - nothing here is guessed.

- `baseUrl` points at the LIVE server: https://skiacrm.nextechltd.in/api. To test, set `baseUrl` to the testing server https://devcrm.nextechltd.in/api (also saved as the `testingBaseUrl` variable) - please test there, not on live.
- All endpoints (except Login/Refresh/Logout/Register, and the handful of genuinely public or webhook endpoints noted in their own folder/description) require `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`. This collection handles that for you via the `accessToken` collection variable - just run "Login" first and every other request will auto-use the token.
- Every response is wrapped as `{ success: boolean, data: ..., message?: string }`. On error: `{ success: false, message: string, errors?: ... }` with a 4xx/5xx status code.
- Most endpoints are gated by a permission string (shown in each request's description, e.g. `leads.view`). If a user's role doesn't have that permission, the API returns 403.
- A few folders (Public QR, Public Website Leads, Support Tickets (Frappe Helpdesk sign-in), and specific webhook routes inside the Integrations folders) are genuinely NOT behind a user token - their descriptions explain the real mechanism (rate limiting only, or a shared-secret/HMAC signature header). Those are marked `noauth` and are mostly not relevant to a mobile app's own login flow.
- This collection folds in and supersedes FieldForce-Login-Leads.postman_collection.json (Auth + Leads folders are unchanged / reused here) and adds every other module in the CRM.

## What changed - refreshed 2026-11-25 (vs the 2026-11-20 version)

- **This document (2026-11-24):** `baseUrl` now points at LIVE (https://skiacrm.nextechltd.in/api); testing server in `testingBaseUrl`. The **Access** line of Pick Up This Lead, Search Requests (leave), List Team Claims and Search Claims corrected to the real permission. Support tickets (Helpdesk) now opens at **https://helpdesk.nextechltd.in** (`GET /sso/launch` sends the browser there).

**New endpoints:**
- `PATCH /levels/{id}/archive` and `PATCH /levels/{id}/restore` - archive/restore a role (`levels.delete`, Admin). People on it keep everything.
- `GET /leave/pending-oversight` - Admin view-only list of pending leave waiting on other managers (`leave_requests.view_all`).

**Removed endpoints:**
- `PATCH /fofo-onboarding/steps/{stepId}/decide` - FOFO onboarding no longer has an approval chain (2026-11-25).

**Changed behaviour (same URLs):**
- **FOFO push needs no approval (2026-11-25).** `POST /fofo-onboarding/{leadId}/push` works straight away - no reporting-manager approval and none of the 5 handoff steps (applicant, store, documents, commercials, go-live) need to be filled. The only requirement is the lead's mobile number (it becomes the store owner's SKIA FOFO login); without it -> 422. Push is now gated by the new permission `fofo_onboarding.push` (Admin, Manager **and Field Sales**). `GET /fofo-onboarding/{leadId}` no longer returns `approvalSteps` (now `{ lead, documents, consent }`). `PATCH /fofo-onboarding/steps/{stepId}/decide` is **removed**, and the Approvals inbox/history no longer contain `onboarding_push` items (leave + expense only). `fofo_onboarding.manage` now only means verifying documents.
- **Permissions are per person now.** `permissions` from Login / `GET /auth/me` = role + per-person overrides, and every endpoint checks that same list. A deactivated account gets **401** "This account has been deactivated" on its next request - log the user out. New permission strings: `leads.claim`, `levels.delete`, `leave_requests.view_all`, `expense_claims.view_all`.
- **Call Center can create from the Leads page.** Call Center now has `leads.view` + `leads.create`; their `POST /leads` works like `POST /leads/queue` (owned by them, starts at New, message "Lead added to your queue"). `POST /leads/{id}/claim` is gated by `leads.claim`.
- **Activity scheduling clashes -> 409** on Create Activity (lead / opportunity), Update Activity and Create Teams Meeting: a person can't have two overlapping calls/meetings/visits, and a lead can't get the same activity type twice within 15 minutes. `errors.dueDate` has the message, `errors.suggestedDueDate` the next free time.
- **Leave cover = same role.** `GET /leave/context` `peers` = active colleagues with the caller's role (company-wide); `POST /leave` refuses any other `coverUserId` (422). Leave requests now include `approverName` / `secondApproverName`.
- **Admin oversight (view only).** `GET /leave/search`, `GET /expenses/team` and `GET /expenses/search` also accept the new view_all permissions and then cover the whole company. Deciding stays with each person's own manager (403 for the Admin).
- **Admins report to no one.** A manager on an Admin is ignored on create / refused on update (422); moving someone to an Admin level clears their manager. Giving anyone an archived level -> 422.
- **Levels** now return `isArchived` / `archivedAt`.
- **Role permission matrix** `catalog` always lists every standard permission.
- **Reports** validate their query values (422 on a bad month/date/id).
- **Clearer errors everywhere:** a malformed id or date (e.g. `GET /leads/abc`) now returns **400** "One of the values sent is not valid (for example an id or a date)" instead of 500; saving a value another record already uses returns **409** "This already exists - another record is using the same value"; a link to a missing or in-use record returns **409**.
- **Send to Field Sales / Reassign (2026-11-24):** every active Field Sales person on the lead's pincode is offered (any operation type), never anyone else; candidates include `operationType`; the choose-one 422 also returns `errors.pincode`.
- **Every new lead starts at New** - including Call Center's own Add lead (`POST /leads/queue`, and `POST /leads` by Call Center), which used to start at FLC. FLC is always the deliberate next step (`POST /leads/{id}/start-flc`). Create Own Queue Lead's message is "Lead added to your queue".
- Lead `ownerTeamName` and the reports' "team" value can list several teams, comma-separated (a person can be on more than one team).

**2026-11-20 update - duplicate leads:** one active lead per mobile number. Create Lead, Create Own Queue Lead (Call Center) and Update Lead now return **409** (with `errors.phone`) when the phone already belongs to an active lead; Bulk Import skips such rows. New `GET /leads/duplicate-check` (live check while typing - phone = block, email = warning). List Leads / Export Leads accept `duplicatesOnly=true`; Quick Filter Counts adds `duplicates`. `duplicateOfLeadId` / `duplicateOfFullName` / `duplicateOfLeadNumber` on a lead are now worked out live (the other active lead with the same number), so they also appear on older pairs and clear once one is closed. Website / QR form submissions from a number that already has an active lead no longer create a second lead - they are logged on the existing lead's History (`repeat_inquiry`) and return that lead's number.

**2026-11-11 update - two more QA fixes:** Qualify Lead no longer requires a specific logged call outcome (client decision - the earlier "Call Done And Interested" requirement was removed). Convert Lead to Opportunity's gate is now stricter and more accurate: Qualified alone is no longer enough - the lead must actually be owned by a field employee (i.e. really sent to Field Sales, not just Qualified and still sitting with Call Center) before an opportunity can be created against it. See both requests' own descriptions below for the exact new error messages.

**2026-11-10 update - QA bug-fix pass (two rounds, 33 + 12 items):** new `Leads > Documents` folder - `GET /leads/{leadId}/documents`, `POST /leads/{leadId}/documents`, `GET /leads/documents/{documentId}/file`, `DELETE /leads/documents/{documentId}` (generic per-lead document upload, reusing FOFO Onboarding's own table/files, gated by `leads.view`/`leads.update` instead of a FOFO-specific permission - built for the Consent tab's evidence upload but usable for any lead). Validation tightened on Create Lead: `phone` is now mandatory (10 digits); `pincode`/`storePincode` (if given) must be 6 digits; `gstNumber` (if given) must be a valid GSTIN. New business-rule gates (both 422, both detailed in their own request descriptions below): Qualify Lead now requires the lead's last logged call disposition to be "Call Done And Interested"; Convert Lead to Opportunity now requires the lead to have already reached Qualified stage (was previously allowed from any stage, including brand-new leads). Get Opportunity History now includes a "created" entry it previously omitted entirely.

**2026-11-05 update - the "never permanently delete" pass:** a full audit found 10 modules whose Delete button quietly hard-deleted the row (or, for Leads/Opportunities, had no archive view/restore at all even though they already soft-deleted). All 10 are fixed the same way - delete is now always archive (soft, recoverable), with a matching Restore endpoint and an `archived=true` query param on the List endpoint to see what's archived. Newly added: `PATCH /leads/{id}/restore`, `PATCH /opportunities/{id}/restore`, `PATCH /delegations/{id}/restore`, `PATCH /approval-bands/{id}/restore`, `PATCH /targets/{id}/restore`, `PATCH /commission-rules/{id}/restore`, `PATCH /user-incentive-plans/{id}/restore`, `PATCH /user-commissions/{id}/restore`, `PATCH /customer-contacts/{id}/restore`, `PATCH /customer-addresses/{id}/restore`. Plus a FOFO-document-specific version of the same idea (old uploads were already being archived on replace/remove, but nothing ever read that log back): `GET /fofo-onboarding/{leadId}/documents/{docType}/history`, `GET /fofo-onboarding/documents/archive/{archiveId}/file`, `PATCH /fofo-onboarding/documents/archive/{archiveId}/restore`. Also: Support Ticket creation now rejects leads that haven't reached Qualified/Converted stage yet (was previously open to any lead at any stage), and the ticket Assignee list now excludes Call Center accounts (they have no access to Support Tickets at all).

**2026-11-02 update - newly added since the last version:** `POST /auth/change-password`; `POST /leads/queue` (Call Center's own "Add lead"); `GET /leads/sources`, `GET /leads/handed-off`, `GET /leads/export`, `GET /leads/{id}/timeline` (these existed on the backend before but were missing from this collection); the whole new "Call Center Lifecycle" folder under Leads - Log Call Disposition, Push to FLC, Pick Up This Lead, Qualify Lead, Escalate to SLC, Get Swap Candidates, Send to Field Sales, Reassign Lead; `createdFrom`/`createdTo` date-range filters on List Leads and Export Leads; `GET /reports/call-center-performance` and `GET /reports/field-sales-performance`; `GET /integrations/whatsapp/webhook` (verification handshake).

## What changed - refreshed 2026-11-19 (vs the 2026-11-11 version)

**Removed (the endpoints no longer exist - stop calling them):**
- Whole `/support-tickets` API (list / create / get / status / assign / messages / reply) and `GET /leads/{id}/support-tickets` - tickets moved to Frappe Helpdesk. See the new folder "Support Tickets (Frappe Helpdesk sign-in)".
- `/integrations/frappe/webhook/*` (server-to-server, never used by the app).

**New:**
- `GET /sso/launch` - open Helpdesk with one click (in a browser, see that folder) + reference-only SSO routes.
- `GET /customers/{id}/support-portal` and `POST /customers/{id}/support-portal/invite` - a customer's support-portal access and invite email.
- `GET|POST /lead-inquiry-options`, `PATCH /lead-inquiry-options/{id}` - the lists behind a lead's Inquiry Category / Inquiry Source.
- `POST /leads/{id}/whatsapp-messages/media` - send a photo/video/document over WhatsApp.
- `GET /public/whatsapp-media/{file}` - WhatsApp attachment files (public).
- `GET /approvals/history` - what I've already approved/rejected.
- `POST /integrations/helpdesk/sync` - Admin "sync now".

**Changed behaviour (same URLs):**
- `POST /leads/{id}/microsoft/email` - attachments now also accept **CSV**.
- `GET /integrations/status` - now also returns `helpdesk` (true/false).
- Leads visibility for Call Center: a **Qualified** lead that hasn't been sent to Field Sales yet now stays in every Call Center Executive's queue (`GET /leads?status=Qualified` returns it with `inOwnerScope: true`), whoever qualified it. It leaves their queue once it's sent to Field Sales.
- Marking an opportunity **Won** (`PATCH /opportunities/{id}` with stage `won`) now automatically gives that customer support-portal access and emails them an invite.

request.description:
**Access:** NO login token (public, or protected some other way - see below)

No auth required. Rate-limited. On success, response is:
```
{
  success: true,
  data: {
    user: { id, name, email, role, designation, managerId, salesTeamId, zoneId, stateId, districtId, areaId, mobile, territory, employeeCode, status, isActive, permissions: string[], ... },
    accessToken: string,   // short-lived JWT, send as 'Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>'
    refreshToken: string   // long-lived, use with /auth/refresh
  },
  message: "Login successful"
}
```
This request's Tests script auto-saves `accessToken`/`refreshToken` into the collection variables, so every other request in this collection authenticates automatically.

**Success response (from the controller code):**
- HTTP 200 - `{ success: true, data: <result>, message: "Login successful" }`
- On error: `{ success: false, message, errors? }` with a 4xx/5xx code (422 = validation failed, `errors` lists each field).

**Fields accepted (JSON body)** (from the backend validator, 2026-11-20 - anything not listed is ignored):
- `email`: string - **required**
- `password`: string - **required**

**Update (2026-11-23):** `permissions` is now the user's **effective** list: their role's permissions plus any per-person overrides an Admin set (extra grants added, revokes removed). Every endpoint checks this same list, so use it to show/hide features. New permission strings: `leads.claim`, `levels.delete`, `leave_requests.view_all`, `expense_claims.view_all`. Call Center now also has `leads.view` and `leads.create` by default.

**Access:** NO login token (public, or protected some other way - see below)

No auth header required - the refresh token itself is the credential. Call this when the access token expires instead of logging in again. Response: `{ success: true, data: { accessToken: string }, message: "Token refreshed" }`. Auto-updates the `accessToken` collection variable.

**Success response (from the controller code):**
- HTTP 200 - `{ success: true, data: <result>, message: "Token refreshed" }`
- On error: `{ success: false, message, errors? }` with a 4xx/5xx code (422 = validation failed, `errors` lists each field).

**Fields accepted (JSON body)** (from the backend validator, 2026-11-20 - anything not listed is ignored):
- `refreshToken`: string - **required**

**Access:** NO login token (public, or protected some other way - see below)

Revokes the given refresh token server-side. Always returns success even if the token was already invalid/expired - the client should discard its local tokens regardless. Response: `{ success: true, data: null, message: "Logged out" }`.

**Success response (from the controller code):**
- HTTP 200 - `{ success: true, data: null, message: "Logged out" }`
- On error: `{ success: false, message, errors? }` with a 4xx/5xx code (422 = validation failed, `errors` lists each field).

**Fields accepted (JSON body)** (from the backend validator, 2026-11-20 - anything not listed is ignored):
- `refreshToken`: string - **required**

**Access:** any logged-in user (Bearer token)

Requires: valid access token (no specific permission). Returns the logged-in user's full profile plus their resolved `permissions` array - use this to decide what to show/hide in the mobile app. Response: `{ success: true, data: { id, name, email, role, ..., permissions: string[] } }`.

**Update (2026-11-23):** `permissions` is now the user's **effective** list: their role's permissions plus any per-person overrides an Admin set (extra grants added, revokes removed). Every endpoint checks this same list, so use it to show/hide features. New permission strings: `leads.claim`, `levels.delete`, `leave_requests.view_all`, `expense_claims.view_all`. Call Center now also has `leads.view` and `leads.create` by default. A deactivated account now gets **401 "This account has been deactivated"** on its very next request (not only when the token expires) - treat it like a logout.

request.description:
**Access:** logged in + permission `users.create`

called with an ADMIN's own access token (not public self-signup - there's no public registration in this API). Included here for completeness since it lives on the auth router, but the mobile app's own login screen will only ever call Login/Refresh/Logout/Me above.

Either `role` (admin/manager/agent) or `levelId` must be provided. Response: `{ success: true, data: <new user object>, message: "User created" }`, 201.

**Success response (from the controller code):**
- HTTP 201 - `{ success: true, data: <user>, message: "User created" }`
- On error: `{ success: false, message, errors? }` with a 4xx/5xx code (422 = validation failed, `errors` lists each field).

**Fields accepted (JSON body)** (from the backend validator, 2026-11-20 - anything not listed is ignored):
- `name`: string - **required**
- `email`: string - **required**
- `password`: string - **required**
- `role`: "admin" | "manager" | "agent" | "call_center" - optional
- `managerId`: string - optional
- `salesTeamIds`: array of string - optional
- `districtId`: string - optional
- `areaId`: string - optional
- `smartfloAgentNumber`: string - optional
- `mobile`: "" | string - optional
- `territory`: string - optional
- `employeeCode`: string - optional
- `status`: "active" | "on_leave" | "onboarding" | "exited" - optional
- `levelId`: string - optional
- `operationType`: "COCO" | "FOFO" | "Both" - optional
- `pincodes`: array of string - optional

**Update (2026-11-23):** **Admins report to no one:** for a user on an Admin-tier level, a `managerId` is ignored on create and refused on update (**422** "Admins sit at the top of the org and don't report to anyone"); moving someone INTO an Admin level clears their manager automatically. Giving someone an **archived** level -> **422** `"<name>" is archived - restore it before giving it to anyone` (a person keeping the level they already had is fine). A blank `territory` is saved as null.

**Access:** any logged-in user (Bearer token)

Requires: valid access token (no specific permission - every role, including Call Center and Field Sales, can change their own password). `newPassword` must be at least 8 characters. Response: `{ success: true, data: null, message: "Password changed" }`.

**Success response (from the controller code):**
- HTTP 200 - `{ success: true, data: null, message: "Password changed - please log in again" }`
- On error: `{ success: false, message, errors? }` with a 4xx/5xx code (422 = validation failed, `errors` lists each field).

**Fields accepted (JSON body)** (from the backend validator, 2026-11-20 - anything not listed is ignored):
- `currentPassword`: string - **required**
- `newPassword`: string - **required**

Only `fullName` and `phone` are required - every other field is optional (there are ~50 optional fields across Customer/Contact/Inquiry/Store/FOFO/Consent tabs; the body above shows commonly-used ones). **2026-11-10 update**: `phone` is now mandatory (10 digits) - blank -> 422 "Phone number is required", wrong format -> 422 "Enter a 10-digit mobile number". request.description:
**Access:** logged in + permission `fofo_onboarding.push` (Admin, Manager and Field Sales), and the lead must be in the caller's own scope (their lead or their team's).

No body. Registers the store owner's SKIA FOFO app login using the lead's own name and **mobile number**, then marks the lead pushed and returns the handoff. **No approval and no handoff step is required** - push as soon as the client is interested; the 5 steps can be filled before or never. Each push is recorded in the audit log (`pushed_to_onboarding`).

**Success response (from the controller code):**
- HTTP 200 - `{ success: true, data: { lead, documents, consent }, message: "Pushed to onboarding app" }` (`lead.pushStatus` = "pushed", `lead.onboardingAppId` = reference code). If the phone already has a SKIA FOFO account from another franchise the message says so - still a success.

**Errors:**
- 422 - "Add the client's mobile number to this lead first - it becomes their SKIA FOFO app login" (lead has no mobile).
- 422 - "This lead was already pushed to the onboarding app on <date>" (each lead is pushed once; the same person's other franchise leads are fine).
- 403 - no permission, or the lead isn't in your scope. 404 - lead not found.
- 409 - a push for this lead is already in progress.
- 502 - SKIA rejected the registration (message says why; nothing was saved). 503 - SKIA integration not configured on the server.

item.description:
Support tickets now live in **Frappe Helpdesk** - FieldForce no longer has its own ticket API (the old `/support-tickets` endpoints and `/leads/{id}/support-tickets` were removed). The app does not read or write tickets through FieldForce at all.

**How the app opens Support tickets:** open `{{baseUrl}}/sso/launch` in a browser / in-app browser tab (NOT an API call with a Bearer token). FieldForce signs the person straight into Helpdesk with one click:
- Admin -> sees all tickets; Field Sales -> sees their own customers' tickets; Call Center -> gets a "No access" page.
- The one-click works off a sign-in cookie that the FieldForce **web** login sets. In a fresh in-app browser there's no such cookie yet, so the person is sent to the FieldForce web login page once, then lands in Helpdesk.

The other routes here are called by Frappe's servers or by a customer's browser - listed for reference only; the app never calls them.
